title: AlyrionSMP
description: A modded SMP with a special twist.
body:
_We are not in offline mode. We support ely.by and littleskin, so we are free to play - there is only the "offline-mode" option in the tags._

# Welcome to Alyrion 7
I am Axo, from the Democratic Communist Union, and I want to present our world to you.
Alyrion is more then yet another modded SMP, and here is why:
## No Coordinates or Minimaps
Please, dont go away! Many people think this is a bad choice, before they play. But disabling coordinates or any modded way to coordinate, you have to learn to know your environment and build infrastructure. We always wonder why exploration isn't fun in minecraft, or many other games: **Its this**.
## Questing
Alyrion has a questline made with much love that evolves with the Server. It is getting expanded all the time, seeing what the players could use.
## Yeah, Create, BUT!
Create is used so often, and its out of place many times. We also have create, and a lot of additions to make it even more immersive and fun, but it is not out of place in Alyrion, as Alyrion is **Steampunk-Themed**.

You can join now by just downloading the Modpack, no IP needed at all. If you are having troubles, find everything you need at the Links section, right here in this page.
